bias.zh: 强势看多 · 短线超买

read.en: Zscaler is breaking out. It is up 19% in five sessions and 42% in twenty, closed near the high of the day on Oct 9, and has its averages stacked in bullish order with all four rising. MACD crossed up on Oct 7 and is accelerating, and Parabolic SAR has been below price since Oct 6. RSI hit 73, which is overbought: strong trends can stay overbought, but chasing here carries more risk.
read.zh: Zscaler 正在突破。五个交易日上涨 19%，二十个交易日上涨 42%，10月9日收于全日高位附近，四条均线全部上行并呈多头排列。MACD 于 10月7日金叉并加速，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起位于股价下方。RSI 达 73，属超买：强势趋势可持续超买，但此时追高风险较大。

read.en: Price is now at December 2025 highs ($235), with $250 the next overhead level and $280–293 (last August and September) beyond that. On a pullback, $217 (the Oct 8 close and a January pivot) is first support, then $205–207 (10-day average), then $191–194 (SAR and 30-day average). Holding above $205 keeps the breakout intact.
read.zh: 股价已触及 2025年12月高点（$235），上方下一阻力为 $250，再往上是去年8、9月的 $280–293。若回调，首个支撑为 $217（10月8日收盘及1月转折点），其次 $205–207（10 日均线），再次 $191–194（SAR 与 30 日均线）。守住 $205 则突破有效。
